label: Copy phase: fed-back x early in long sequences, with next output x or r
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and only when the fed-back input is x (100% of activations; in_tok x has 33x lift). It never fires in the original or delimiter phase or on any other input token. Within copy-phase x inputs it is very selective. The output is almost always x (67% of mass) or r (21%), so the pattern is the bigram xx or xr. It is concentrated at recall_idx 3-4, meaning x was original token 2 or 3, and in long sequences (L=9 holds 62% of mass, none for L<=4). Activation is largest for L=9 with x at original position 2 followed by x, e.g. x 1 x x ... reaches 1.0. The predicate covers 74% of activation mass on dev, but precision is only about 0.23: many matching xx/xr steps stay silent, so the conditions are necessary-ish but not sufficient. Context beyond these variables is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: recall_idx=3 & in_tok=x (+3.65), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+2.47), phase=2 & out_tok=x (+2.31), out_tok=x (+2.29), in_tok=x (+1.96), phase=2 & out_tok=r (+1.74). Lower it: prev_tok=s (-1.69), orig8=- (-1.45), prev2_tok=<DEL> (-1.45), prev_tok=y (-1.31).
